_comment: Test cases for the ai-news-digest skill. The first four need no LLM judgment and are run by evals/run_script_evals.py; the rest evaluate editorial judgment and need a human or an LLM judge.

evals.description: Collection respects the time window and does not break when a feed is down.
expect: exits 0 even with sources failing
counts.items_deduped > 0
every item is published inside the window
the three feedless sources appear in sources_failed with an explicit reason
sources_ok[].off_topic > 0 for Canaltech and TecMundo
release feeds drop pre-releases: sources_ok[].prerelease > 0 for at least one tool

evals.description: The card never exceeds the Teams limit: it drops the coldest items first.
expect: compact payload <= 6000 bytes
the HIGH items survive the trim
the footer says how many items were dropped

evals.description: A malformed digest fails with a useful message, not a traceback.
expect: exit code != 0
the message names the card and the missing field
a temperature outside HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW is rejected with a readable message
ALTA/MEDIA/BAIXA are accepted as aliases
the output contains neither the query string nor the secret
--dry-run makes no network request
with no webhook configured, the error explains how to configure it

evals.description: The same story across several outlets becomes a single card.
evals.scenario: The NVIDIA acquisition of Hugging Face runs in 7 sources, including NVIDIA Blog (en) and TecMundo (pt-BR).
expect: a single card, not seven
the main source is the NVIDIA Blog (primary), not an outlet covering it
the other outlets appear in also_covered_by
the Portuguese card does not become a separate item

evals.description: Temperature measures relevance to the committee, not popularity.
evals.scenario: A day with: (a) a billion-dollar acquisition that reshapes the tooling market, (b) a consumer GPU launch, (c) an arXiv cs.SE paper on agent harnesses, (d) an EU AI Act compliance deadline, (e) Claude Code shipping four versions whose notes are only bug fixes.
expect: (a) is HIGH and (d) is HIGH
(b) is not HIGH, despite the volume of coverage
(c) is LOW or MEDIUM, with the research lens
(e) is a single LOW card or is left out entirely, never four cards
between 2 and 5 HIGH items in total

evals.scenario: Half the sources return 403 because the environment has Network access = Trusted.
expect: the newsletter says up front that collection was partial
the failing sources are listed with their reason
the card count is lower rather than padded with noise
the reply points at the Network access setting

evals.description: A thin day does not become an inflated newsletter.
expect: publishes 6 cards, not 15
explicitly says the day was thin
does not promote a LOW item to MEDIUM to fill space

evals.description: The newsletter keeps its engineering focus instead of following press volume.
evals.scenario: A day with 90 general AI press items and 14 engineering items, including releases from Claude Code, Codex and Zed, two GitHub Changelog entries and 10 arXiv cs.SE papers.
expect: roughly 8 of the 15 cards are engineering
a tool release card says what changed, not that a release happened
several versions of one tool become a single card
the quiet feeds are not crowded out by the louder press
